mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength supporting corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases in the prior month but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP (GDPC1) decline and monthly housing starts (HOUST) drop signal severe economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates severe manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year window.
